summary: Froze the shared-cost allocation contract as a docs-only slice written into project/specs/PH-305.md (per the Lead's BASE correction, the whitelist has no docs/adr/ path, so no new ADR file was created and report discloses this). The frozen contract covers: the shared pool definition limited to company-level posted cost facts (non-project/unallocated labor via PH-217, company-level bank-charge cost via PH-250, later company expense slices otherwise null+missing), excluding direct project cost/cash/draft/reversed/cross-org sources so T09 total cost is not double counted; append-only SharedCostAllocationBatch with at most one effective batch per org+period+pool_kind and correction only by negative reversal; driver enum revenue_cents/approved_minutes/direct_cost_cents/fixed_weights with the first three sourced read-only from their owners; integer basis points summing exactly 10000, ROUND_HALF_UP per target with the stable last target absorbing the residual and sum equal to the pool amount, no client-supplied amounts; no net company cost increase and no direct ledger edits (costing/ledger owner append-only re-scope); read-only shared_cost_reconciliation with frozen issue codes; request_token receipts, org lock, dry_run, period/lock checks; immutable history with reversal+new batch in an open period and algorithm_version (no migration-free recomputation); role matrix with history_read when the module is disabled; explicit owner boundaries (costing owns facts, contracts/management_revenue/time provide read-only drivers, cash untouched, core via existing commands, insights/invoicing read-only); and the relation to PH-313 (implementation prerequisite, this contract does not authorize implementation and adds no canonical topic/command).
